req.title: Empty player list returns empty array
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players when the table is empty with HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array.
triggers: empty player list returns empty array

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-025 requires GET /players/ to return HTTP 200 and an empty JSON array when the player table is empty. The database contract states 26 rows are pre-loaded before every test, so a test for the empty-collection case must delete all 26 rows via the API first. Three tests are designed: (1) positive — after deleting all pre-loaded players, GET /players/ returns 200 and []; (2) negative — with players present, GET /players/ returns 200 but a non-empty array (proving the empty-array response is state-dependent, not a constant); (3) boundary — the transition from exactly 1 player remaining to 0 players, verifying the boundary between non-empty and empty. Each test asserts exact status codes and exact body values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players (squad numbers 1-26)
All 26 players are deleted via DELETE /players/squadnumber/{n} before the GET
actions: Delete all 26 pre-loaded players via DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}
trace: R-PLAYER-025: system shall respond with HTTP 200 and empty JSON array when table is empty
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_players_empty_table_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    squad_numbers = list(range(1, 27))
    for sn in squad_numbers:
        del_resp = client.delete(f'/players/squadnumber/{sn}')
        assert del_resp.status_code == 204

    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert body == []
    assert len(body) == 0
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert response.headers['content-type'].startswith('application/json')

tests.name: test_get_players_non_empty_table_returns_200_and_non_empty_array
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 players (squad numbers 1-26)
actions: Send GET /players/ without deleting any players
expected: Response body is a JSON array with exactly 26 items (not empty)

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_players_non_empty_table_returns_200_and_non_empty_array():
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert body != []
    assert len(body) == 26
    squad_numbers = [p['squadNumber'] for p in body]
    assert 1 in squad_numbers
    assert 26 in squad_numbers

tests.name: test_get_players_last_player_deleted_returns_empty_array
preconditions: 25 players are deleted, leaving exactly 1 player
GET /players/ with 1 player returns a list of length 1 (not empty)
The final player is then deleted
actions: Delete players with squad numbers 1-25 (leaving squad number 26)
Assert GET /players/ returns exactly 1 item (boundary: non-empty side)
Assert GET /players/ returns exactly [] (boundary: empty side)
expected: Transition from length 1 to length 0 is the exact boundary
trace: R-PLAYER-025: BVA on collection size — boundary between 1 item and 0 items
Catches off-by-one mutations in empty-check logic (len > 0 vs len >= 0, etc.)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_players_last_player_deleted_returns_empty_array():
    for sn in range(1, 26):
        del_resp = client.delete(f'/players/squadnumber/{sn}')
        assert del_resp.status_code == 204

    resp_one = client.get('/players/')
    assert resp_one.status_code == 200
    body_one = resp_one.json()
    assert isinstance(body_one, list)
    assert len(body_one) == 1
    assert body_one != []
    assert body_one[0]['squadNumber'] == 26

    del_last = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert del_last.status_code == 204

    resp_empty = client.get('/players/')
    assert resp_empty.status_code == 200
    body_empty = resp_empty.json()
    assert body_empty == []
    assert len(body_empty) == 0
    assert isinstance(body_empty, list)
